evidence.reason: The scan only inspects `.wants`/`.requires` contents when `_directory_probe(entry)` reports a real directory. Under the no-follow policy, a symlink to a dependency directory yields `is_dir == False`; the earlier symlink check only catches aliases resolving to declared unit files, so a symlinked `ingress.target.wants` pointing at a directory containing `crq-tick.service` is neither inspected nor refused. Systemd can follow that directory symlink and load the hidden dependency, allowing discovery to report complete/supported incorrectly. This is an ordinary correctness gap in the existing no-follow scan; refusing unexamined dependency-directory symlinks is the smallest compatible repair.
